name: DoorBird Intercom
description: Rings the panel for a local DoorBird call button and opens live video. Listen, talk, use quick actions and control ringing from Home Assistant. No cloud or restreamer required.
author: Björn Fischer

settings.title: DoorBird address
settings.description: IP address or hostname of the DoorBird on your local network, for example 192.168.1.50. Do not include http://.

settings.title: Username
settings.description: A DoorBird user, usually ending in 0001. Give it Watch always permission for manual live view outside a ring.

settings.title: RTSP port
settings.description: Normally 554. Change it only if your DoorBird uses another RTSP port.

settings.title: Name
settings.description: Shown at the top of the viewer. Empty shows Front door, in the plugin's language.

settings.title: Ring on this device
settings.description: Off: a press does not play the chime, wake the screen or open the call screen here. Last ring and the Doorbell pressed trigger still follow presses.

settings.title: Play a chime
settings.description: A ding-dong when the button is pressed.

settings.title: Chime volume
settings.description: How loud the chime itself is. 40 is a soft chime, 100 as loud as it goes.

settings.title: Chime sound
settings.description: Which Android volume the chime follows.

settings.title: Pause music
settings.description: Pauses the kiosk's music during a doorbell call, and resumes it when the viewer closes. Only music that was playing is paused and resumed.

settings.title: Wake the screen
settings.description: Turn the screen on and close the screensaver when the button is pressed.

settings.title: Restore the screen
settings.description: After a ring woke the screen, turn it off again or start its previous screensaver once the call screen closes.

settings.title: Close the viewer after
settings.description: After a doorbell press, while nobody touches it. Speaker or Answer stop the countdown. Opened by hand, it stays open.

settings.title: End a call after
settings.description: Once answered or opened by hand, so a forgotten call does not keep the room on the line.

settings.title: Video
settings.description: Default uses /mpeg/media.amp. The explicit 720p and 1080p paths depend on the DoorBird model and firmware.

settings.title: Call volume
settings.description: How loud the doorbell plays on the panel. The viewer has a slider for it too.

settings.title: Microphone
settings.description: Which Android microphone source talks to the door. Automatic takes the first that opens, Camcorder first.

settings.title: Talk mode
settings.description: Hands free keeps the microphone open during a call. Push to talk sends your voice only while you hold the microphone button and turns the door's sound down meanwhile.

settings.title: Microphone sample rate
settings.description: The rate the microphone is opened at. DoorBird audio itself is always converted to 8000 Hz.

settings.title: Android call mode
settings.description: Switches Android to call mode on the loudspeaker during a call, which most devices need for echo cancelling.

settings.title: Wake word muted by a call
settings.description: Managed by the plugin.

settings.title: Music paused by a call
settings.description: Managed by the plugin.

settings.title: Call volume to restore
settings.description: Managed by the plugin for crash recovery.

settings.title: Language
settings.description: For the viewer, readings and messages. Automatic follows the panel's Android language.

settings.title: Call buttons
settings.description: The round buttons at the bottom of the call screen, in this order. Add your own actions, such as opening a door through Home Assistant.

settings.title: Cards
settings.description: Cards above the call buttons. Each can run a chosen action and show a Home Assistant entity's live state.

fields.title: State
fields.description: A Home Assistant entity whose state the card shows. Optional.

buttons.title: Check the DoorBird
buttons.label: Check
buttons.description: Checks credentials, encrypted event setup, video, listening and talking.
